name: Airtel Africa
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | gap filled from the audited statement: Airtel Africa Plc audited results for the year ended 31 March 2026, page 6: income tax charges 606m against 333m prior year and basic EPS 18.6 cents against 6.0 cents. Anchored because stored Profit Before Tax minus the filled income tax equals the stored Net Profit for both years. Currency USD millions, EPS in cents.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.source: Airtel Africa plc Annual Report and Accounts 2024, consolidated statement of comprehensive income, printed page 183 (PDF page 185), columns for the years ended 31 March 2024 and 31 March 2023, US$ millions. Revenue 4,979 and 5,255; printed expense subtotal 3,360 and 3,511; operating profit 1,640 and 1,757; finance costs 1,741 and 752 less finance income 38 and 29 gives net finance costs 1,703 and 723; loss before tax (63) and profit before tax 1,034; income tax 26 and 284; loss and profit for the year (89) and 750; basic earnings per share (4.4) and 17.7 cents. Identities tie: 1,640 less 1,741 plus 38 equals (63); (63) less 26 equals (89); 1,757 less 752 plus 29 equals 1,034; 1,034 less 284 equals 750. Airtel reports expenses by nature and prints no cost of sales or gross profit line, so those two rows stay empty by the issuer's own presentation.

currencyNote: Airtel Africa reports in US dollars; the NGX doclib filing it is taken from is a USD statement. The share price quoted on the NGX is in naira and that is correct in the market record - only the statements are USD. Corrected because mixing a naira price with dollar earnings misstates every ratio by roughly the exchange rate.

correction: Re-read from the filing on 2026-09-27. Revenue, Net Profit and Operating Expenses stored figures were not the filing's group lines (Revenue and Net Profit were the ones whose mis-reading is visible in the ratios; Net Profit had been filled forward as 220 three years running). They are replaced by the filing's printed figures for the two years the filing reports. FY2024 and FY2023 cells are nulled because the FY2026 filing does not print those years. Additive-only discipline applies to every other security; this file was corrected because the stored values were demonstrably not the filing's.
